extension.summary: Nocturne - your library after hours, explored by torchlight.
extension.description: The museum has closed for the night. Every poster, still and cover hangs on a dark plaster wall, and a warm pool of light follows your focus, gliding from frame to frame. Brass plaques, dust in the beam, a listening room under a pendant lamp. Built for the NVIDIA Shield (Kodi 21 Omega).
extension.news: v0.9.19 - Seasons, episodes, films and results say "1 season" etc. instead of "1 seasons". Brass plaques: the title and the year / running time now sit on one baseline, with room before the screws. Smaller download: removed images the skin never used. v0.9.18 - Empty pages no longer print their message over the Back frame, and the listening room's lamp no longer hides the Sort words.
